parameters.body: SELECT toString(d) AS date   FROM (     SELECT (SELECT max(date) FROM analytics.ads_daily) + number + 1 AS d     FROM numbers(30)   )   WHERE d < today()   FORMAT JSON

=  SELECT
    count()                                                         AS rows_loaded,
    {{ $('Simulate Google Ads API').first().json.row_count }}      AS rows_expected,
    countIf(cost < 0 OR clicks > impressions OR conversions > clicks) AS bad_rows,
    rows_loaded = rows_expected AND bad_rows = 0                    AS passed
  FROM analytics.ads_daily FINAL
  WHERE date IN ('{{ $('Simulate Google Ads API').first().json.dates.join("','") }}')
  SETTINGS output_format_json_quote_64bit_integers = 0
  FORMAT JSON
